title: feat: record website referrers in the cloudflare traffic sync
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The daily Cloudflare traffic sync now records `page_referrers`: aggregate counts for pollinations.ai page routes by referring hostname, status and browser. It stores `clientRefererHost`, never referrer paths or queries, in the existing raw table; the dataset is estimated at about 1,200 groups and 330 KB per day, below the 10,000-group limit. Referrers are fetched after the other datasets for each requested day, so a referrer failure cannot prevent those datasets from being fetched. The script and manual workflow now accept `--dataset` and dataset-specific `--days` limits: 7 for all or `host_views`, 30 for `page_views`, and 89 for `page_referrers`, allowing a single dataset to be backfilled without reappending the others. A new Websites dashboard panel shows visits by referrer host and site, counting browsers only, excluding verified bots and using the latest fetch for each day; it shows No data when no referrer data is available. A 30-day panel load reads about 10 MB. Cloudflare retains roughly 90 days for this zone, with full detail for about 34 days and roughly 10× sampling beyond that; an 89-day `page_referrers` backfill is available through a manual run. On Enter, `github.com` and `accounts.google.com` referrers can include people returning from sign-in.
